verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own FAQ says hosted users have full control over their data and can delete all of it by deleting their organization and user account, which covers the deletion half of the story. The pack shows no configurable retention periods or per-event/per-project purge controls. Self-hosting options and SDK sampling rates are adjacent controls and earn no credit. Missing for 10: configurable data retention windows, granular (per-project/per-event/per-issue) deletion controls, documented retention policy for hosted data, independent corroboration.
